generation.prompt:
Edit this image. Keep exactly the same camera, framing and composition, the same architecture (the half-timbered merchant street, the stalls, the quay, the canal, the bridge, the castle on the hill) and the same characters in the same places. Keep the HD-2D look: a 3D diorama with pixel-art character sprites, soft tilt-shift depth of field, painterly light, slightly desaturated colours. Change only the time of day and the light, to daytime on the day of the city's tournament: lanterns and windows unlit; add only a few pennants and banners in the town's colours along the frontage and on the bridge, no new buildings, no extra clutter. Keep the restrained palette: slate blue and cool stone dominant, ivory canvas, sunlight as the warm accent. No text, no logos, no watermark.
Time: midday. A high sun, crisp short shadows under the awnings, a clear blue sky with a few white clouds, bright but not saturated, the canal reflecting the sky.
